test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is the main reason that Prime Minister Narendra Modi meet Mr. Michal Spiczko, President of the Kabaddi Federation of Poland?

options.text: To congratulate him on Poland's football achievements
To appreciate his efforts in promoting Kabaddi in Europe
To sign a trade agreement between India and Poland
To discuss military cooperation through sports

solution:
The correct answer is __**To appreciate his efforts in promoting Kabaddi in Europe**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi met Mr. Michal Spiczko, President of the Kabaddi Federation of Poland, to **recognize his efforts in promoting Kabaddi as a sport in Europe**.
 
• Mr. Spiczko has been instrumental in **introducing and popularizing Kabaddi in Poland and other European countries**.
 
• The meeting reflects India's commitment to fostering **global interest in traditional Indian sports**.
 
• Kabaddi, a sport with roots in India, has gained **increasing international recognition and participation** in recent years.
 
• This interaction aligns with the Indian government's efforts to **promote cultural and sports diplomacy** on a global platform.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kabaddi:**

 
 
• Kabaddi is an ancient Indian contact sport that combines **strength, strategy, and team coordination**.
 
• The game is widely played in South Asia and has become a key feature of the **Asian Games**.
 
• It includes variations such as **circle-style Kabaddi** and **standard-style Kabaddi**.
 
• India is a dominant force in international Kabaddi, consistently winning championships.
 
 
 
• **Sports Diplomacy:**
 
 
• Sports diplomacy refers to the use of sports as a tool to **build international relationships**.
 
• It helps in fostering goodwill, cultural exchange, and mutual respect among nations.
 
• India has leveraged traditional sports like Kabaddi to strengthen ties with countries globally.
 
 
 
• **Kabaddi in Europe:**
 
 
• European countries, including Poland, have shown **growing interest** in Kabaddi over the past decade.
 
• Efforts by organizations like the Kabaddi Federation of Poland have led to **structured leagues and tournaments**.
 
• Such initiatives contribute to the global expansion of this indigenous Indian sport.
 
 
 
• **Globalization of Indian Sports:**
 
 
• India has been actively working to globalize its traditional sports like Kabaddi and Kho-Kho.
 
• These sports are introduced at international events to **showcase India's rich cultural heritage**.
